def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,5)]
    if len(marks)<2: return out
    upper=[m for m in marks if m[0] < len(grid)//2]
    lower=[m for m in marks if m[0] >= len(grid)//2]
    if len(upper)>=2:
        ordered=sorted(upper,key=lambda m:m[1]); left,right=ordered[0][2],ordered[-1][2]
    elif upper and lower:
        left=sorted(lower,key=lambda m:m[1])[0][2]
        right=sorted(upper,key=lambda m:m[1])[0][2]
    else:
        ordered=sorted(marks,key=lambda m:m[1]); left,right=ordered[0][2],ordered[-1][2]
    rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[j]==5 for row in grid)]
    top,bottom=min(rows),max(rows); lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
    for i in range(top+1,bottom):
        for j in range(lo+1,hi):
            k=((i-top-1)//2+(j-lo-1)//2)%2
            out[i][j]=left if k==0 else right
    return out

    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (0,5)]
    if len(marks)<2: return out
    upper=[m for m in marks if m[0] < len(grid)//2]
    lower=[m for m in marks if m[0] >= len(grid)//2]
    if len(upper)>=2:
        ordered=sorted(upper,key=lambda m:m[1]); left,right=ordered[0][2],ordered[-1][2]
    elif upper and lower:
        # Upper marker color fills the upper-left cell pattern; lower marker supplies the other.
        u,l=upper[0],lower[0]
        left,right=(l[2],u[2]) if u[1] >= len(grid[0])//2 else (u[2],l[2])
    elif len(lower)>=2:
        ordered=sorted(lower,key=lambda m:m[1]); left,right=ordered[0][2],ordered[-1][2]
    else:
        ordered=sorted(marks,key=lambda m:m[1]); left,right=ordered[0][2],ordered[-1][2]
    rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[j]==5 for row in grid)]
    top,bottom=min(rows),max(rows); lo,hi=min(cols),max(cols)
    for i in range(top+1,bottom):
        for j in range(lo+1,hi):
            k=((i-top-1)//2+(j-lo-1)//2)%2
            out[i][j]=left if k==0 else right
    return out
